conclusion: HWCS's structural edge over N1 is modest and cost-model conditional. Against the STRONG N2 baseline (mask-then-bin), HWCS does NOT reliably win: at kappa=1 it loses in all states; only in the optimistic kappa=0 limit does it edge N2, and then only marginally. Therefore no HWCS structural dominance can be claimed off N1 alone; N2 must be beaten on MEASURED GPU time before any CODEX_GO discussion.
